layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Iguanodon thumb spike morphology
features: A close-up of a sturdy clay Iguanodon forelimb and hand
A sharp, conical thumb spike made of off-white, bone-textured clay pointing upwards
The hand features three middle fingers pressed together and a flexible pinky finger
Skin made of olive-green clay with realistic hand-molded wrinkles and fold patterns
The thumb spike has a matte, slightly weathered texture compared to the smoother skin
layer_3_action.action: A cinematic macro shot focusing on the unique defensive thumb spike. The hand is positioned as if resting on the ground in a quadrupedal stance. The background is a soft-focus prehistoric plain with scattered clay trees. No text.
